title: LLM game reply (strict form)
description: The decision object the model is asked to return each round. In substance identical to PromptBuilder.DECISION_SCHEMA, which is sent as response_format.json_schema.schema on every game call (check_schemas.py verifies the equality after removing annotation keywords). DecisionParser.decision is more lenient than this schema and applies its rules in a fixed order (INTERFACES.md e.4): a finite numeric or string quote is decided before decline, so {"quote": 2.09, "decline": true} is OK and {"quote": "abc", "decline": true} is INVALID; string quotes use Double.parseDouble; text after the first JSON value is ignored.

quote.description: Half-spread on the grid s0 + j*quoteIncrement in [s0, sBar]; null = decline to quote (REFUSED).

plan.description: One or two sentences; carried into the next round's prompt (truncated to 300 characters).

rationale.description: Reasons, briefly. Not parsed; survives only in the cache file text.
